details: Michael Saylor's Strategy has significantly increased its Bitcoin holdings by acquiring another 34,164 BTC for approximately $2.5 billion. This acquisition brings their total Bitcoin stash to over 800,000 BTC, signaling continued strong institutional confidence and accumulation.
title: Strategy Purchases Additional 34,164 Bitcoin

details: Bitcoin's price experienced volatility over the weekend, initially dipping due to escalating Middle East tensions but then surging past $77,000 after Iran reportedly reopened the Strait of Hormuz. The market remains sensitive to geopolitical developments.
title: Bitcoin Price Fluctuates Amidst Geopolitical Tensions

details: Morgan Stanley has reportedly increased its Bitcoin holdings to approximately $102.02 million, reflecting a growing trend of traditional financial institutions integrating digital assets into their portfolios. This move highlights the increasing institutional adoption of Bitcoin, often through investment products like ETFs.
title: Morgan Stanley Increases Bitcoin Exposure to $102 Million

details: Ethereum investment funds recorded $328 million in net inflows last week, marking the largest weekly inflow since January. This significant capital injection brings year-to-date net inflows for Ethereum products to $197 million, indicating renewed investor interest in the second-largest cryptocurrency.
title: Ethereum Funds See Largest Weekly Inflows Since January

details: Sberbank, Russia's largest banking institution, has announced its readiness to offer cryptocurrency trading services once the necessary regulatory frameworks and organized exchange trading are established. This development could significantly expand crypto accessibility and adoption within Russia.
title: Russia's Sberbank Prepares for Crypto Trading Services

details: The $RAVE cryptocurrency experienced a dramatic 95% crash, wiping out billions from its market capitalization, following allegations of insider manipulation. This event serves as a stark reminder of the inherent volatility and risks, including potential misconduct, within the broader altcoin market.
title: $RAVE Cryptocurrency Crashes 95% Amid Manipulation Claims
